items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1961-02-16
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Piran made some records, you ever hear them? ... [INTERVIEWEE] Do you think it was a good example of how they played?

ctx.x: I don't know. That band, you know that band had a different style of playing. But the old jazz band used to do it. Yeah, they'd make a tag. Did you ever hear them records they made?
Piran made some records, you ever hear them? Yeah, yeah, I heard lots of records of Piran bands.
Do you think it was a good example of how they played?
